heading: Everything you might want to know before we begin.

faqs.question: How long does a typical project take?
faqs.answer: It depends on the scope. A focused website typically takes three to five weeks. A full product with AI integrations and automation can range from six to twelve weeks. We will give you a precise timeline during our strategy session before any work begins.

faqs.question: Do you work with businesses that are just starting out?
faqs.answer: Absolutely. Some of our best work has been with founders who were building their digital presence from scratch. If you have a clear vision for your business, we have the expertise to bring it to life.

faqs.question: What makes Webvance different from a typical web agency?
faqs.answer: We start with your customer, not with a template. Every decision we make is rooted in understanding how your audience thinks and what moves them to act. The result is a digital product that performs, not just one that looks good.

faqs.question: Will I be able to manage my website after it is built?
faqs.answer: Yes. We build everything with ease of management in mind and provide full handover documentation and a training session so you feel completely in control of your digital product after launch.

faqs.question: Do you offer ongoing support after launch?
faqs.answer: We do. We offer monthly retainer packages covering performance monitoring, content updates, SEO and continuous optimisation. We treat launch as the beginning of the relationship, not the end.

faqs.question: How do we get started?
faqs.answer: Simply reach out through our contact form or book a call directly. We will schedule a discovery session, learn about your business and come back with a clear strategy and proposal within five working days.
